text:
Alex W: heads-up: seeing a flurry of enforcer rejects during last peak + metering lag. Repro timeline below, looks like writeback is ~30-90s behind for affected orgs
Priya Nair: ugh, saw spikes in RejectedByEnforcer metric too. Any recent enforcer config changes?
Alex W: we rolled hedging fallback last week (routes to cheapest region then enforces locally). hypothesis: hedged requests hit an enforcer before the original metering write arrives
Mateo R: that makes sense. Hedging -> duplicate request ids -> enforcer counts immediately, metering writes later from primary. Do we have idempotency keys propagated to metering?
Linh Tran: current path uses request_id for logging but we don't attach a monotonic sequence for the billing pipeline. Metering writes are aggregated by session and can be reordered through Kafka partitions
Casey M: short-term: can we add a grace window where enforcer treats a missing bucket as "pending" for Xs instead of rejecting? Even 60s would massively reduce customer-facing rejections
Priya Nair: agree. Could be config: `enforcer.grace_seconds: 60` + metric `enforcer.grace_applied` to track usage. Low-risk and feature-flagged
Alex W: +1. Also want an out-of-band backfill: scan enforcer rejections for orgs with later metering writes and auto-reconcile credits. But need to avoid double-granting
Mateo R: backfill plan: 1) identify rejections with request_id/trace_id 2) check if metering write landed within window 3) if so, mark rejection as reconciled and decrement enforcement counter. We'll need a safe idempotent operation on enforcer state
Linh Tran: technical snag: enforcer runs in multiple datacenters, state is local. We could use a writeback queue to push reconciliation ops to each enforcer replica (via service bus) so local state is updated idempotently
Casey M: For monitoring: add a dashboard tile showing "enforcer rejects vs metering lag" with heatmap per org and 95th percentile lag. That will help product triage and billing disputes
deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature-flag `enforcer_grace_window` v2 -> staging @ 2067890200 by @deploy-bot :rocket:
Priya Nair: test plan for grace window: 1) enable flag for 10 internal orgs 2) run synthetic hedging traffic 3) assert rejects drop and no double-allow 4) monitor `billing.reconciled_rejects` metric
Alex W: action items:
- Priya: push feature flag to staging + dashboards (ETA today)
- Mateo: sketch reconciliation job + idempotency contract (ETA EOD)
- Linh: prototype writeback queue for enforcer update (ETA 48h)
- Casey: dashboard and alert thresholds (ETA tomorrow)
Mateo R: small note: we should also explore propagating a `hedge_id` header so downstream metering can annotate writes as hedged. That'll make reconciliation easier and avoid double-counting
Linh Tran: agreed. Also will add partitioning tweak to Kafka consumer to reduce reorder for billing topic
Alex W: thanks. We'll roll grace window to 10% first and watch `billing.disputed_charges` and `enforcer.reject_rate`. If all good, expand.
Priya Nair: logging snippet we can add to enforcer to aid forensic: ```json
{"request_id":"...","hedge_id":"...","enforcer_decision":"reject|allow","metering_seen":true|false}"```
Casey M: ping me when staging flag is up, I'll wire the dashboard panels and alert runbook
Alex W: we'll reconvene tomorrow after staging results. low-latency wins :) :thumbsup:
